subject: INLA sometimes stuck in infinite loop

messages.author: 1475e652f3d71feb
messages.subject: INLA sometimes stuck in infinite loop
parts:
Hi,

I recently updated INLA from an early 2024 version to the most recent version. Since I updated INLA occasionally gets stuck in what appears to be an infinite loop. Running with verbose I get output similar to the following:

Reset 'best' as we are unable to reproduce it: [53.808587] --> [53.811326]

maxld= -53.8086 fn=8719 theta= 4.4874 9.0890 [733.16, 0.001]

Enable early_stop ff < f0: 53.808587 < 53.811410 (diff 0.00282316)

Early stop. Mode not found sufficiently accurate f0=[53.811410] f_best=[53.808587] local.value=[53.808587]


Enable early_stop ff < f0: 53.811326 < 53.811653 (diff 0.000327381)

Early stop. Mode not found sufficiently accurate f0=[53.811653] f_best=[53.808587] local.value=[53.811326]


Reset 'best' as we are unable to reproduce it: [53.808587] --> [53.811326]

maxld= -53.8086 fn=8725 theta= 4.4874 9.0890 [733.16, 0.001]

Enable early_stop ff < f0: 53.808587 < 53.811410 (diff 0.00282316)

Early stop. Mode not found sufficiently accurate f0=[53.811410] f_best=[53.808587] local.value=[53.808587]

it goes on like this seemingly forever. If I repeat the fit, but with some modification to the starting position or step it often converges just fine. Is there a way to make iNLA break off this loop with an error? 

Many thanks in advance,
Best regards,
Eirik
